open-question.question: By what means does a hand-answer runner see the standing recommendations on the other open questions, so that it can judge which of them its answer undermines, given that the answer core's `locate` prints only the answered block and `answer-open-question-with-alternative` tells its runner never to read `open_questions.xml` itself?

In which runtime file does the step that names the standing picks an answer undermines live, given that the shared answer core `core/shared/answer-procedure.md` is also followed by the answer sweep and by `/answer-open-question-with-recommendation`, neither of which may perform that step?

What is the test by which a hand-answer runner decides that its answer undermines another question's standing recommendation: is a pick undermined only when its recommended option can no longer be carried out as written, or also when the option still works but the recommendation's stated rationale rests on something the answer changed?
When a hand answer records the same option that the answered question's own standing recommendation names, does the runner still judge the other questions' standing picks against that answer?

What does the open-question tool's `remove` do when a Short Title passed to it as an undermined dependent matches no block in the document, or names the block being removed, given that the answer core folds the decision into `requirements.md` before it calls `remove`?
What does the open-question tool's `remove` do when a block passed to it as an undermined dependent exists but carries no `<recommendation>` element?
After a hand answer has cleared the standing picks of other open questions, does the hand-answer skill tell the user which questions lost their pick, beside its one `Answer recorded.` status line?

Should `/modify-milestone-goal` clear the standing recommendations that a goal revision undermines, and if it does, are the picks that declared a dependency on a cleared pick through a `<depends-on>` tag cleared along with it?
Which historical stale-pick cases does the replay cover: only the cases found in this repository's own milestone history, or also the cases found in other local projects that use the workflow?
In a replayed case, by what record is each standing pick classed as stale or as unaffected, so that the count of stale picks cleared and the count of unaffected picks left standing can both be taken?
Is the replay's result a bar the milestone must meet before it can be finished, or a measurement that is reported whatever it shows?
Where in the committed repository, if anywhere, is the replay's aggregate result recorded?
